opening.argument: The walkthrough opens as a HaasOnline training session for the InterExchange Arbitrage Bot, then explains how its cross-exchange trading settings work. Viewers are shown trade-amount and trigger-level controls, and the speaker explains that funds must be moved between exchanges to keep balances aligned. Those are operational details, not a promise of earnings. The description expressly calls the strategy risky and disclaims any guarantee of profits or freedom from losses. It also promotes TradeServer with a coupon and free trial, but that commercial offer alone does not establish deception. Nothing in the cited material makes a specific deceptive earnings claim or asks viewers to transfer money or private data.

citations.quote: Welcome back to the HaasOnline training series. In this session we're going to take a look at the InterExchange Arbitrage Bot.
